biotools.summary: R Shiny app for automated high-throughput explorative analysis of multivariate behavioural data. The app is designed to provide an easy access to fundamental analysis techniques such as clustering, boxplot visualization and pairwise comparisons, heatmaps, principal component analysis (PCA), correlation matrices and pairwise correlations.
biotools.name: beeRapp

metadata.abstract: Summary: Animal behavioral studies typically generate high-dimensional datasets consisting of multiple correlated outcome measures across distinct or related behavioral domains. Here, we introduce the BEhavioral Explorative analysis R shiny APP (beeRapp) that facilitates explorative and inferential analysis of behavioral data in a high-Throughput fashion. By employing an intuitive and user-friendly graphical user interface, beeRapp empowers behavioral scientists without programming and data science expertise to perform clustering, dimensionality reduction, correlational and inferential statistics and produce up to thousands of high-quality output plots visualizing results in a standardized and automated way.
metadata.title: BeeRapp: An R shiny app for automated high-Throughput explorative analysis of multivariate behavioral data
